title: Profile
one_line: Tall popup: avatar straddling the top edge, player ID with copy, STATS and BADGES tabs.
gaps: Ground is periwinkle #6C7A9C. Menus sit on bg_menu_emboss - but see the deviation: this becomes a popup over the hub, so it gets a scrim, not a ground.
Stat labels are about 5-7 pt. Minimum is 12.
It is a full screen with no title treatment at all. Decision D4: it becomes a tall popup.

anatomy.spec: ground.scrim at 72 percent over the hub, which stays visible and dimmed (bible 4.3).
Tall standard NX Card, 380 wide, cream rim 10, Lucky Six corners. Max height = screen - top inset - 120; content scrolls, card does not.
84 pt, straddling the TOP EDGE of the card, ringed by the frame tier, with the level badge at the bottom (bible 4.3, 5.14). The nameplate sits just inside, under it.
The player's name, CAPS, Lilita 22, ink.plaque.

Player ID with a copy glyph to its right (tapping copies and toasts 'Copied'), and the joined date as a caption. The ID must be selectable and copyable - it is how friends add each other and how support identifies an account.
Folder tabs on the top edge under the nameplate: STATS / BADGES.
3 x 3 grid of wells (bible 5.6). Each: a big number in Lilita, a caption under it. NINE STATS MAXIMUM - the current screen squeezes in far more and none of them read.
Grid of wells holding badge art. Locked ones are faded with a lock glyph on a disabled disc, and tapping one says how to earn it.
EDIT PROFILE, option amber, button L, straddling the bottom edge in a 6 pt cream collar.
44 cream disc X, 24 pt below. No back button - it is a popup.

copy.badges_empty: Play matches to earn your first badge.

states: Own profile - EDIT PROFILE and SHARE present.
Another player's profile - no EDIT; ADD FRIEND (info) replaces it, or REMOVE FRIEND (neutral, going through a confirm) if already friends.
No badges yet - empty state (bible 5.22): faded emblem at 40 percent, a title, one line telling the player what to do.
Guest account - a line offering Link Google, since a guest loses everything on reinstall. This is worth saying plainly.
motion: Open and close: tokens.json motion.popupOpen / popupClose.
Stat numbers count up over 600 ms when the tab opens.
data: StatsService for the numbers, AvatarService for the avatar and frame tier, AchievementService for badges.
Player ID comes from the Firebase uid at T-A2. Until then, the local demo ID - but never present a demo ID as permanent.

assets_needed.name: Badge art
assets_needed.prompt: Medals already exist in Assets/Art/UI/Medals. Re-export at 3x and add locked variants as a disabled disc plus a lock glyph.

deviations: Bible 6.5 and decision D4: Profile moves from a full screen to a tall popup, so it gets a scrim over the hub rather than its own ground. D4 recommended yes; confirm with the owner before building if it is still unanswered.
do_not: Do not show more than nine stats. Squeezing thirty tiny numbers onto one screen is the current problem.
Do not let any stat label fall below 12 pt.
Do not give the popup a back button or its own background colour.
Do not make the player ID unselectable - it must be copyable.
Do not show badge slots with no explanation of how to earn them.
acceptance: Nine stats maximum, every label 12 pt or larger, every number readable at arm's length.
Avatar straddles the top edge with the frame-tier ring and the level badge.
Player ID copies to the clipboard and toasts.
Both tabs work; the badges tab has an empty state.
Viewing another player shows ADD FRIEND instead of EDIT PROFILE.
The card never scrolls; its content does.
steps: 1. Preflight. Confirm decision D4 with the owner if it is still open - popup or full screen changes the whole build.
2. Rebuild as a tall NX Card popup with a scrim, the avatar straddling the top edge and the nameplate inside.
3. Add the identity block: player ID with copy, joined date, SHARE.
5. Cut the stats to nine, in a 3 x 3 of wells, every label at 12 pt or more.
6. Build the badges grid with locked variants and an empty state.
7. Add the other-player variant with ADD FRIEND / REMOVE FRIEND.
8. Add the guest-account line offering Link Google.
9. Capture own, other, empty-badges and loading. Postflight.
prompt:
Rebuild the Ludo NX Profile as a tall popup.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md sections 6.5 and 4.3, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

Check decision D4 in AI_HANDOFF.md first: Profile moves from a full screen to a tall popup. If D4 is still unanswered, ask the owner before building - it changes the whole job.

As a popup: scrim over the hub, tall NX Card 380 wide, the avatar at 84 pt straddling the TOP EDGE with its frame-tier ring and level badge, the nameplate just inside under it, then the player ID with a copy glyph, the joined date, and SHARE in info blue. Folder tabs STATS / BADGES. EDIT PROFILE in a collar on the bottom edge. Close X 24 pt below.

The single most important fix: the current screen crams in far more than nine stats at about 5-7 pt each, and none of them can be read. NINE STATS MAXIMUM, in a 3 x 3 of wells, big number over a caption, nothing below 12 pt.

The player ID must be genuinely copyable - it is how friends add each other and how support identifies an account. Tapping the copy glyph copies it and toasts.

Build the other-player variant too (ADD FRIEND instead of EDIT PROFILE), the badges empty state, and - if the account is a guest - one plain line offering Link Google, because a guest loses everything on reinstall.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
